text:
nora: Heads-up: spike outcome attached. Proposal: a thin proxy shim for /v1 -> /v2 that handles payload reshape, streaming passthrough, and a small set of safety heuristics. Goal: transparent migration with observable deltas.

vik: Can you call out streaming constraints? We have clients that rely on chunk boundaries.

nora: Streaming plan: prefer passthrough for chunked responses (no re-chunking). If we must transform payload (v1 envelope -> v2), we do transform only at message boundaries and preserve the stream framing bytes. Add header X-Shim-Stream: transformed|passthrough.

eli: How do we handle partial responses/timeouts? If v2 times out after partial stream, do we fallback to v1? That could duplicate tokens.

nora: Avoid fallback after partial body for safety. Fallback allowed only if no bytes have been sent to client. If fallback would cause duplication we instead surface 502 with X-Partial-Response: true and a troubleshooting id.

queenie: Edgecase: clients expect older embedding dim (512)-> new model 1536. How will we signal embedding schema changes?

vik: Good point. We should add a compatibility header and a shape-check step: if client requests dim=512 but v2 produces 1536, shim will reject with 409 + guidance URL unless tenant opted into auto-downsample.

nora: Two opt-in modes for embedding clients: downsample (lossy) or strict-block. Downsample requires tenant opt-in flag (migration.feature=emb-downsample).

eli: Auth/ratelimit interactions? If shim mints service tokens, we need to attribute rate usage back to tenant API key and preserve per-tenant quotas.

nora: We will carry X-Orig-Key-ID through the pipeline and use it for quota accounting. Token minting is ephemeral and only used internally; audit logs map ephemeral token -> original key.

queenie: Observability: what metrics/alerts?

nora: Add metrics: shim.request.count, shim.transformed.count, shim.passthrough.count, shim.fallback.count, shim.partial_error.count. Add histogram for shim.latency and a regression alert if shim.partial_error rate > 0.1% over baseline.

vik: Testing: unit for transformers, blackbox against a v2 stub, and an integration harness that replays production capture. Also do shadowing for 72h at 5%.

eli: What about header trimming by downstream load balancers? We saw proxies drop long Set-Cookie and X-* headers. Shim should copy essential headers into a JSON body envelope if header size > 4k.

nora: Yes, add header-sanitize stage. For headers over threshold we attach a small compressed blob at /_shim_meta (not sent to client) and put pointer header X-Shim-Meta-ID. Only for internal debugging, access-controlled.

infra-bot: infra-bot: canary deploy queued: shim-proxy v0.2 -> canary at 7765432120 :rocket:

queenie: Docs & comms: migration doc must include: example curl mappings, streaming notes, embedding policy, error codes (409 for embedding mismatch, 502 for upstream failures, 429 preserved), and an explicit deprecation timeline (90d notice + 6mo hard sunset).

eli: Rate-limit semantics: preserve 429 as-is. If shim retries on 5xx upstream, make retries idempotent and bounded, and surface Retry-After when applicable.

vik: Also consider per-tenant debug mode that enables full request/response logging to signed S3 URLs for 24h. Needs approval checkbox in console.

nora: Owners: nora (lead), vik (tests/harness), eli (safety/fallback policy), queenie (docs/comm). Next steps: PR for proxy impl, RFC appendix with exact error mappings + header whitelist, and a canary runbook. I'll open tickets by EOD.

docs-bot: docs-bot: created doc stub at https://redwood.docs/migrations/v1-to-v2-shim-guide

vik: :thumbsup: let's run the 72h shadow and then validate embedding dim metrics before any opt-ins.

nora: Agreed. Scheduling follow-up check-in after shadow window. Thanks all!
